d.d: The (cognitive, mental, or emotional) viewpoint of a certain person; (attributively) from that viewpoint.
A discourse marker signalling "imagine, if you will, being in the situation that this text, photo, or video depicts", even in cases where third-person viewpoint exists; compare also fourth wall joke.
The vantage point of a particular person; (attributively) from that vantage point.
The quality or state of being poor; lack of money
A deficiency of something needed or desired
